import nanosurf
import time

# Initialize AFM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController

# Set to non-contact mode
opmode.Mode = "Dynamic"  # Non-contact mode

# Set appropriate Z controller parameters for non-contact mode
zcontrol.SetPoint = 70  # % of free amplitude
zcontrol.PGain = 1000
zcontrol.IGain = 1000

# Define scan areas (in meters)
scan_sizes = [1e-6, 2e-6, 5e-6, 10e-6]  # 1µm, 2µm, 5µm, 10µm

for i, size in enumerate(scan_sizes):
    # Configure scan parameters
    scan.ImageWidth = size
    scan.ImageHeight = size
    scan.Points = 256
    scan.Lines = 256
    scan.Scantime = 1.0  # 1 second per line
    
    # Start the scan
    print(f"Starting scan {i} with size {size*1e6}µm")
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    
    # Wait for scan completion (rough estimate)
    time.sleep(scan.Lines * scan.Scantime + 5)  # Add 5 seconds buffer

# Clean up
del spm
